profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: A rising tide lifts all boats, and I aim to contribute to that tide. I am a pragmatic Staff Software Engineer with over 10 years of software engineering experience and technical leadership. My expertise includes enterprise level backend development, design, implementation and delivery. I am passionate about helping others finding a way to drive things forward.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical Lead for the IronDefense backend, a sprawling pipeline of 35+ microservices. Served as the
company’s Java expert, providing help navigating through Java specific issues as well as mentoring
across teams on Java specific coding practices.

• Worked closely with Product Managers to determine what customers wanted from the product
and provide the PMs with feasibility analysis, offering up alternative solutions when things were
determined to be infeasible.
• Mentored teammates on general development best practices and helped tweak our overall
process so that it was easier to follow best practices.
• Automated dependency upgrades for our repositories as well as updated a number of our build
processes to account for ensuring FedRAMP compliance.
• Refactored several microservices to increase our throughput ten-fold while reducing overall CPU
usage
• Spearheaded the migration from JDK8 to JDK17 for all of the Java-based microservices.
Navigated the company through Log4Shell vulnerabilities, by analyzing our security exposure and
path to rectification.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Leadership · Scrum · Java Development · Constructive Feedback · Software Architecture · Agile Methodologies · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Risk Assessment · Product Requirements · Object Oriented Design · Docker Products · Software as a Service (SaaS) · Apache Kafka · Protocol Buffers · Data Driven Testing · Microservices · Spring Framework · Java · Leading Development Teams · gRPC · Mentoring · Distributed Systems · Kubernetes · Go (Programming Language) · Software Design

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: As part of the OCI - Object Storage organization, I am currently working on a high-performance replacement for our Vert.x based web servers. This involves designing an implementing a highly durable web server capable of sustained throughput of large, continuously streaming payloads. This also involves a number of DevOps hurdles including deployment strategies, soak testing, and how to replace an existing production piece in a transparent fashion.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Developer
positions.description:
As the management software architect, and lead engineer, I led the effort of integrating the Oracle FS-1 into the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure team's Block Storage offering. 
+ Providing full stack design on the Oracle FS-1 side to ensure that all necessary hooks could be exposed by the management software.
+ Facilitated communication between various teams of the Oracle FS-1 with specific emphasis on coordinating efforts between the various management software teams and the newly formed Oracle FS-1 Control Plane.
+ Helped design and implement the Oracle FS-1 Control Plane
+ Helped manage the development efforts of several management software teams including the control plane team by identifying and ranking key pieces of work that needed to be implemented to optimize business value and code maintainability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Hired on as an Associate Software Engineer, I quickly became a contributing member of the team.  I worked on the management software for the Pillar Axiom 500.  It was comprised of a backend written in Java and communicating over a proprietary protocol with a standard Java GUI. My primary focus was the backend, though I did dabble briefly with the GUI.  My careful thoughts to design and my pragmatic nature led to me being promoted to the title of Software Engineer.
positions.insights: Skills: Constructive Feedback · Object Oriented Design · Spring Framework

positions.title: Software Engineer, Researcher
positions.description:
Worked as part of a team of researchers to design and develop various simulations to solve academic and defense related problems. 

Conference Papers:
Herve, J. Y., Mullen, B., Vicente, T. F. Y., Allen, C. T., Morace, C., & Otterness, I. (2010). Using a Game Engine to Integrate Experimental, Field, and Simulation Data for Science Education: You Are the Scientist!. GSTF Journal on Computing(JoC), 1(1).

C.T.S. Allen and T.F. Yago Vicente, “Multirepresentational Modeling and Analysis of the Local Topographical Properties of Knee Articular Cartilage for Early Arthritis Detection,” abstract in ACM Communications in Computer Algebra Issue 172.

Conference Presentations:
“Multirepresentational Modeling and Analysis of the Local Topographical Properties of Knee Articular Cartilage for Early Arthritis Detection,” East Coast Computer Algebra Day, University of Rhode Island, Kingston, RI, May 2009.

“Visualizing the Deformation of Articular Cartilage During Dynamic Motion of the Knee,” CCSCNE, College of the Holy Cross, Worcester, MA, April 2006.

positions.title: REU (Research Experience for Undergraduates) Intern
positions.description: Expanded knowledge of constraint based implicit fitting to mesh points and their effects. Developed heuristics for the propagation of force on multiple implicit surface representations interacting with one another.
